'''Chukwuma "Chuma" Okeke''' (born August 18, 1998) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]].<ref name="ostendorf">{{cite web |last1=Ostendorf |first1=Greg |title=Getting to know Chuma Okeke |url=https://auburntigers.com/news/2018/2/7/Getting_to_know_Chuma_Okeke.aspx |publisher=Auburn University Athletics |accessdate=May 16, 2019 |date=February 7, 2018}}</ref>

==High school career==
Okeke attended [[Westlake High School (Georgia)|Westlake High School]] in [[Atlanta]]. As a junior, he won the Georgia Class 6A state championship, scoring 13 points in a 68–58 win over [[Pebblebrook High School]].<ref name="purdum">{{cite web |last1=Purdum |first1=David |title=Class AAAAAA boys: Westlake 68, Pebblebrook 58 |url=https://www.ajc.com/blog/high-school-sports/class-aaaaaa-boys-westlake-pebblebrook/qZeB4jm7XtYD2EJUCSAIrN/ |website=[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]] |accessdate=May 16, 2019 |date=March 5, 2016}}</ref> Okeke was named [[Mr. Georgia Basketball]] after his senior season, through which he averaged 24.4 points, 15 rebounds and 2.4 steals per game.<ref name="sinor">{{cite web |last1=Sinor |first1=Wesley |title=Auburn signee Chuma Okeke is Georgia's Mr. Basketball |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2017/03/auburn_signee_chuma_okeke_is_g.html |publisher=AL.com |accessdate=May 16, 2019 |date=March 24, 2017}}</ref> He was a consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and was ranked among the top 50 players in his class by some scouting services.<ref name="profile">{{cite web |title=Chuma Okeke |url=https://auburntigers.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=3835 |publisher=Auburn University Athletics |accessdate=May 16, 2019}}</ref>

==College career==
In his freshman season with [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], Okeke averaged 7.5 points and 5.8 rebounds per game. He grabbed 197 rebounds in the season, the most by an Auburn freshman since [[Jeff Moore (basketball)|Jeff Moore]] in [[1984–85 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|1984–85]].<ref name=profile/>

As a sophomore, Okeke averaged 12 points, 6.8 rebounds, 1.8 steals, and 1.2 blocks per game while starting in all 38 games.<ref name="realgm">{{cite web |title=Chuma Okeke Player Profile |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Chuma-Okeke/Summary/88842 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=May 16, 2019}}</ref> On March 29, 2019, in a Sweet 16 win over first-seeded [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] at the [[2019 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2019 NCAA Tournament]], he tore his [[Anterior cruciate ligament|ACL]] and was injured for the rest of the tournament. Despite his absence, Auburn advanced to its first Final Four appearance in program history.<ref name="teicher">{{cite web |last1=Teicher |first1=Adam |title=How Auburn survived without (and because of) Chuma Okeke |url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26410108/how-auburn-survived-of-chuma-okeke |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=May 16, 2019 |date=March 31, 2019}}</ref>
